description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultGrainActivator class, which is responsible for creating and disposing grain instances in the Orleans runtime. It utilizes dependency injection and factory patterns to instantiate grains and manage their lifecycle.

classes.name: DefaultGrainActivator
classes.description: Implements IGrainActivator to create and dispose grain instances using dependency injection and factory methods.

methods.name: DefaultGrainActivator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the activator with a service provider and grain class type.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain instance using the provided context, handling argument creation and factory invocation.

methods.name: DisposeInstance
methods.description: Disposes of a grain instance, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous disposal patterns.
